title: September 2014 source-corrected legacy rainfall (incomplete)
method: Nonzero PNG byte interpreted as integer mm per historical writer; zero/255 -> null. No fitted multiplier. Native centers explicitly shifted +0.005 longitude and -0.005 latitude; original world files and obsolete decode retained.
domain: Native-center regional crop: -111.695 to -110.495 longitude, 32.795 to 31.695 latitude. Not a delineated basin.
source: Iowa Environmental Mesonet MRMS quantitative PNG archive
license: IEM public-use archive; credit IEM and NOAA; derived radar estimates, not gauge truth

dailyCrossChecks.interpretation: Hourly zero/missing ambiguity prevents a complete pixel-total comparison. Positive-sample sums are lower-bound reconstructions, not complete rainfall totals. See rainfall-source-audit.json.

priorDocumentedPaletteComparison.interpretation: Same endpoint and preceding 24 nonoverlapping hours, common valid cells only. Quantization and product differences mean equality is not assumed; no adjustment applied.

quality.reviewNote: All files present, but missing coverage cannot be recovered from zeros. Previous claim of 967032 valid cell-hours is retracted.

limitations: Historical p1h writer stored integer mm, bypassing its palette conversion. Zero cannot distinguish dry, sub-mm truncation, or missing data: retained as null. Raw NSSL headers were not obtained, so other cast/wrap artifacts cannot be ruled out. Not calibrated or complete rainfall forcing.
Historical half-cell correction is explicit; old geometry remains available for sensitivity comparisons.
No user-owned sensors required: independent existing public data can supply validation.

solverDomain.terrainVerticalDatum: USGS catalog NAVD88; rainfall has no elevation datum
